name: network-monitoring
description: Network Monitoring Tool — React/TypeScript frontend with a Node/Express/TypeScript API

comments.scripts: Commands are spelled out rather than nesting `npm run`, because npm puts every ancestor node_modules/.bin on PATH and an older npm found there would be used for the inner call.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ui -c blue,magenta "tsx watch api/src/index.ts" "vite network-monitoring-ui"
scripts.build: tsc -p api/tsconfig.json && node api/scripts/copy-migrations.mjs && tsc -p network-monitoring-ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p network-monitoring-ui/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && vite build network-monitoring-ui
scripts.build:ui: tsc -p network-monitoring-ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p network-monitoring-ui/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && vite build network-monitoring-ui
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p network-monitoring-ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p network-monitoring-ui/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.ci: biome ci && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p network-monitoring-ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p network-monitoring-ui/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsx --test api/src/**/*.test.ts && vitest run --root network-monitoring-ui
